Ellen has maintained an alphabetical index of Pedlines material since the beginning and while it doesn't include every name in every issue it does offer a guide to material in earlier issues not covered by the email issues index listing.  We do have some print copies gathering dust so if you see an older issue that interests you, drop a line to rontb@earthlink.net and we'll see if the issue you fancy is available.  We think $5 a copy including postage is a fair price.

--Ron
